summary: Iran conducted multiple missile launches from Khuzestan, Kurdistan, and Zanjan provinces alongside a UAV crash in West Azerbaijan, signaling heightened military activity. Israeli unity government talks between Likud and Yashar ended without breakthrough after four hours, with disagreements over draft law and judicial reform persisting. Settler violence erupted across at least four West Bank locations near Ramallah and South Hebron Hills, involving arson and 'revenge' graffiti.
key_points: Iran launched missiles from Qorveh, Kurdistan at 1120Z and from Haftkel, Khuzestan at 0842Z, with additional launch from Zanjan at 1205Z. (Source: @shin_persian/12730, @shin_persian/12725, @shin_persian/12735)
A UAV reportedly crashed near Khoy, West Azerbaijan Province at 1246Z. (Source: @shin_persian/12736)
Concrete shelters were observed moving to Ansar Al Hoseyin IRGC garrison in Hamadan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12721)
Jet activity was heard around Fifth Fighter Base in Omidiyeh, Khuzestan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12729)

Likud and Yashar party negotiations lasted over four hours without agreement on draft law, judicial reform, or state inquiry committee; follow-up meeting scheduled. (Source: @yediotnews25/138327, @N12chat/236403)
IDF Chief of Staff stated military requires increased force levels to meet significantly expanded operational challenges across all arenas. (Source: @amitsegal/67449)

Settler attacks occurred in at least four Palestinian villages near Ramallah and South Hebron Hills overnight, with vehicle arson and 'revenge' graffiti reported. (Source: @yediotnews25/138313, @amitsegal/67430)

Artillery shelling hit Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, Wadi Salouqi, and Zoutar Al-Sharqiya in Lebanon; phosphorus bombs reportedly used on Al-Qasir. (Source: @redlinkleb/54433, @redlinkleb/54430, @redlinkleb/54460, @redlinkleb/54426)

sections.executive_summary: Iran conducted multiple missile launches from Khuzestan, Kurdistan, and Zanjan provinces alongside a UAV crash in West Azerbaijan, signaling heightened military activity. Israeli unity government talks between Likud and Yashar ended without breakthrough after four hours, with disagreements over draft law and judicial reform persisting. Settler violence erupted across at least four West Bank locations near Ramallah and South Hebron Hills, involving arson and 'revenge' graffiti.

points: Two missiles launched from Haftkel, Khuzestan Province at 12:12 local time (0842Z) per delayed monitoring post. (Source: @shin_persian/12725)
Missile launched from Qorveh, Kurdistan Province at 1120Z (14:50 Tehran time) per delayed monitoring post. (Source: @shin_persian/12730)
Launch detected from Zanjan Province at 1205Z (15:35 Tehran time) per delayed monitoring post. (Source: @shin_persian/12735)
UAV reported crashed near Khoy, West Azerbaijan Province at 1246Z (16:16 Tehran time) per delayed monitoring post. (Source: @shin_persian/12736)
Concrete shelters observed en route to Ansar Al Hoseyin IRGC garrison in Hamadan, Hamadan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12721)
Jet activity heard around Fifth Fighter Base in Omidiyeh, Khuzestan Province per delayed monitoring post. (Source: @shin_persian/12729)

Likud and Yashar (Gadi Eisenkot) concluded four-hour negotiation without breakthrough; agreed to exclude rotation issue, focus on draft law, judicial reform, state inquiry committee; Likud demanded Haredi inclusion in draft talks; Yashar opposes government with Ben-Gvir. (Source: @yediotnews25/138327)

IDF Chief of Staff during Southern Command exercise: military monitoring all arenas, requires increased force levels for significantly expanded operational challenges; any major escalation requiring additional forces needs new planning. (Source: @amitsegal/67449)

IDF and Border Police deployed overnight to Deir Assudan, Deir Abu Mash'al, Kfar Malik, A-Tuwani following arson and graffiti reports; Shai District police and forensics preparing to enter scenes secured by IDF for evidence collection. (Source: @amitsegal/67430)

Israeli civilian visited family in Khader village, Syrian buffer zone, after 40 years; wore IDF uniform with Lt. Col. rank but is not an officer, serves in security body; Division 210 investigating. (Source: @yediotnews25/138312)
Yair Golan: no real progress forming government; minority government only realistic alternative; unity with Netanyahu 'knife in voters' back'. (Source: @amitsegal/67442, @yediotnews25/138318)
Arab local authorities head wrote Eisenkot supporting minority government backed by Arab parties, pledging stability. (Source: @N12chat/236397)
Likud and Yashar issued joint statement after 4+ hour meeting: positions presented on substantive issues, detailed discussion held, follow-up meeting scheduled. (Source: @N12chat/236403)

Series of riots and arson in Palestinian villages across Judea and Samaria overnight, at least four locations in Ramallah area and South Hebron Hills; vehicle and property arson attempts, 'revenge' graffiti; no arrests reported. (Source: @yediotnews25/138313, @amitsegal/67430)

Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin met Hamas political leader Khalil al-Hayya and senior delegation in Istanbul to discuss Gaza situation per Turkish security sources. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10313)
IDF condemns settler violence harming public order, diverting attention, undermining stability, and impairing operational and counterterrorism activities. (Source: @amitsegal/67430)
Israeli security forces preparing forensic investigations at multiple West Bank scenes secured by IDF. (Source: @amitsegal/67430)
Artillery shelling reported on Nabatieh Al-Fawqa with live map tracking. (Source: @redlinkleb/54433)
Artillery shelling reported on Wadi Salouqi with live map tracking. (Source: @redlinkleb/54430)
Enemy forces reportedly dropped phosphorus bombs toward Al-Qasir town. (Source: @redlinkleb/54426)
Explosion reported at Zoutar Al-Sharqiya with live map tracking. (Source: @redlinkleb/54460)

Israeli civilian entered Khader village in Syrian buffer zone after 40-year separation, wore IDF uniform with Lt. Col. rank; identified as security body employee, not IDF officer; Division 210 investigating. (Source: @yediotnews25/138312)
UKMTO reported incident involving tanker and military forces in Gulf of Oman; no further details provided. (Source: @N12chat/236406)
US Senate may vote week of Nov 30 to block Trump Saudi nuclear cooperation pact permitting uranium enrichment; Houthi attacks raise reactor security concerns. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10309)

Acting Navy Secretary: Navy may operate with 9 carriers (below 11 legally required) for ~5 years due to Ford-class delays; 17 destroyers on blockade duty straining fleet readiness. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10318)
CENTCOM denies Iranian claim of damaging US F-16 over Gulf; states Iran did not attack F-16, all US fighters accounted for. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10314)
Alleged Iranian tanker approaching US blockade identified as spoof; TankerTrackers confirms vessel doesn't exist, no satellite corroboration. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10317)

Lebanon artillery strikes on Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, Wadi Salouqi, Zoutar Al-Sharqiya; phosphorus bombs alleged on Al-Qasir. (Source: @redlinkleb/54433, @redlinkleb/54430, @redlinkleb/54460, @redlinkleb/54426)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's simultaneous missile launches from three provinces and a UAV crash suggest either a large-scale exercise, readiness demonstration, or potential retaliation posture. The IDF's acknowledged force shortfall and need for new planning amid expanded challenges indicates strain across multiple fronts. Settler violence in the West Bank risks triggering broader Palestinian unrest while diverting IDF resources. Houthi advances toward Aden threaten Yemen's internationally recognized government and could disrupt Red Sea shipping further. Lebanese artillery and phosphorus use signals continued cross-border escalation.
sections.regional_response: Turkey maintains diplomatic channel with Hamas via Kalin-al-Hayya meeting, positioning Ankara as mediator. Arab local authorities endorse minority government backed by Arab parties, potentially enabling Israeli political realignment. US naval posture degradation (9 carriers, 17 destroyers on blockade) reduces deterrence capacity in Gulf. CENTCOM's public denial of Iranian F-16 claim aims to control narrative and prevent escalation. Saudi nuclear pact faces Senate blockade over Houthi threat concerns.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian missile launch data comes from delayed (120-second) monitoring posts via FromIran, providing near-real-time but not instantaneous tracking. The UAV crash in Khoy lacks attribution — could be technical failure, interception, or deliberate test. West Bank settler violence reports lack casualty figures or perpetrator identification. Lebanese artillery reports are map-based alerts without confirmed damage assessments. The Iranian tanker spoof highlights ongoing information warfare targeting maritime domain awareness. CENTCOM's specific denial of F-16 damage suggests Iranian claim was explicit enough to require public rebuttal.
